title: G6 v4: stage leases (final; spec reviews T-0269, T-0282, T-0287 folded in, further spec review waived after three rounds) — direct merges retried by the sweep, retry paths clear done markers, child review tasks re-spawned, count at least expected
spec:
Replaces T-0286 (spec review T-0287), T-0281 (T-0282) and T-0268 (T-0269). Spec review is waived after three rounds by Planner decision; the code review on daemon.py still fires. Problem unchanged: daemon.stamp() claims pipeline.<field> under bus.locked() before a stage acts and nothing clears it, so a crash between stamp and action wedges the task.
Design:
1. Field mapping: for each claim field F in {dispatched_at, spec_review_at, gated_at, merged_at}, stamp(tid, F, ...) also writes pipeline.<F>_lease = now + [daemon].stage_lease_s (pool.toml, default 900); complete(tid, F) writes pipeline.<F>_done = now; both under the lock; callers keep today's F strings. A stamp that also sets status=held writes no lease. Any code path that clears a claim for a retry (merge_reviewed's tests_red branch from F6, and the sweep itself) clears <F>, <F>_lease and <F>_done together through one helper clear_stage(tid, F).
2. complete() calls: dispatch right after spawn_async is issued; spec_review after both bus.create_task and spawn_async of the child have run; gate after the review tasks exist and are spawned, or after the direct merge.merge returned; merge_reviewed after merge.merge returns whatever its status.
3. sweep_leases(pool) runs in tick() after pool.tally_planner() and _load_review_cfg(pool) (so tiers and stage_lease_s are current) and before dispatch(); it considers only tasks with status queued, running or done and only stages that carry a <F>_lease key (pre-lease stamps are never reconciled). For a leased stage with no <F>_done and an expired lease:
   - dispatched_at: only when status is still queued: clear_stage so dispatch() re-runs; running tasks belong to the dead-pid requeue (Codex runs carry no pid); README states this window.
   - spec_review_at: if a spec_review child with inputs[0] == id exists: if that child is still queued with no claimed_at, spawn_async(spawn.run_worker, child) again (spawn claims the task, so a double spawn is refused by the claim); mark done. Else clear_stage.
   - gated_at: if already_merged(): mark done and set merged_into. Else if reviews_expected == 0 (review_reason none): call merge.merge(id) through report_merge exactly as gate() does, then mark done (already_merged makes a repeat harmless). Else count review children with inputs[0] == id: if count >= reviews_expected, re-spawn any child still queued without claimed_at, mark done; if fewer, create the missing reviews through the helper gate() uses (same tier rules), spawn them, mark done.
   - merged_at: if already_merged(): mark done and set merged_into. Else increment pipeline.merge_retries and clear_stage so merge_reviewed() retries; at merge_retries 2 hold with hold_reason 'merge lease expired twice'.
   No 'reviews_expected unset' branch exists.
4. pool.toml [daemon] stage_lease_s = 900 with a comment; README Pipeline replaces the crash-and-retry sentence with the lease rules: done marker, pre-lease exemption, dispatched_at window, direct-merge retry, child re-spawn, held-task exclusion.
5. Tests in tests/test_daemon.py: test_lease_dispatch_rerun_only_when_queued, test_lease_spec_review_respawns_unclaimed_child, test_lease_gate_direct_merge_retried_when_no_reviews_expected, test_lease_gate_creates_missing_second_review, test_lease_gate_done_when_count_at_least_expected (one extra review does not loop), test_lease_merge_retry_then_hold, test_tests_red_retry_clears_done_marker, test_lease_reconciles_already_merged, test_sweep_skips_held_tasks, test_sweep_skips_prelease_stamps, test_hold_stamps_have_no_lease. Every existing test stays green; the harness runs spawn_async synchronously.
acceptance: every existing test_daemon test passes unchanged in intent
pool.toml documents [daemon].stage_lease_s and README describes the lease rules
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree
